title: Verify migration plus control-plane evidence with Supabase provider readback
problem: Merged PR #4169 has official applied migration 20261008162000 and three verified production candidates, but its terminal closure returned PRODUCTION_DESCENDANT_READBACK_NOT_PROVEN despite Supabase-only runtime change.
root_cause: The terminal workflow's migration fast path excluded only docs, tests and brain/learning. It incorrectly classified .agents and canonical platform/system-map verifier-only files as requiring a Netlify release. Production Release Readback excludes Supabase migrations and verifier-only paths, so no canonical website release exists to satisfy that false demand.
decision: Reuse existing canonical isNonProductionPath/verifierOnly authority and migration provider proof, classifying migrations plus recognized nonruntime paths as Supabase-only. Keep mixed, unknown, website and Edge runtime fail closed.
fix: Update terminal scope classifier and workflow with precise migration + nonruntime selector, add regression and negative-scope tests; no new scheduler, proof store or bypass.
prevention_rule: Never infer Netlify release necessity from governance/verifier-only files accompanying a Supabase migration. Supabase-only terminal requires exact official production migration identity. Unknown runtime remains closed.
expected_truth_after_release: Future migration plus nonruntime evidence closures use Supabase provider migration readback; original #4169 completion is not claimed until independently reconciled.
